question: What supernatural powers arise from this stage of practice?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is attained
These are presented as related accomplishments
inference: This practice yields the knowledge of hearing from afar and the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may mean paralysis of fetters or immobilization by bonds
plain_english: O beloved, one gains the knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
